title: roldana guadalajarensis
intro: Roldana guadalajarensis, commonly known as Guadalajara Roldana or Guadalajara Mexican Gold, is a flowering plant species within the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Roldana guadalajarensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of Roldana guadalajarensis may also contribute to its potential therapeutic applications in the management of various diseases, including cancer, Alzheimer's disease, and other neurodegenerative disorders.
